May 22, 2018 - By Louis Casey
Davidson Investment Advisors increased its stake in Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) by 1.98% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Davidson Investment Advisors bought 2,544 shares as the company’s stock declined 9.21% with the market. The institutional investor held 131,227 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $18.34M, up from 128,683 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Davidson Investment Advisors who had been investing in Johnson & Johnson for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $331.84 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.42% or $0.52 $123.72. About 5.56M shares traded. Johnson & Johnson (NYSE:JNJ) has risen 1.12% uptrending. It has underperformed by 10.43% the S&P500.
Thornburg Investment Management Inc increased its stake in Fresenius Medical Care (FMS) by 20.77% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Thornburg Investment Management Inc bought 40,914 shares as the company’s stock declined 4.47% with the market. The institutional investor held 237,891 shares of the hospital and nursing management company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $12.50 million, up from 196,977 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Thornburg Investment Management Inc who had been investing in Fresenius Medical Care for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $30.99B market cap company. The stock increased 0.65% or $0.33 $51.21. About 39,995 shares traded. Fresenius Medical Care AG & Co. KGaA (NYSE:FMS) has risen 18.90% uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.35% the S&P500.
Since February 15, 2018, it had 0 insider buys, and 1 insider sale for $20.17 million activity.
Among 23 analysts covering Johnson & Johnson ( NYSE:JNJ ), 11 have Buy rating, 5 Sell and 7 Hold. Therefore 48% are positive. Johnson & Johnson had 101 analyst reports since August 7, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The firm has “Overweight” rating given on Tuesday, December 1 by Barclays Capital. Credit Suisse maintained the stock with “Buy” rating in Thursday, October 19 report. As per Wednesday, August 2, the company rating was maintained by BTIG Research. The company was maintained on Wednesday, October 14 by S&P Research. The rating was maintained by Wells Fargo on Tuesday, February 6 with “Buy”. RBC Capital Markets maintained the stock with “Outperform” rating in Wednesday, January 25 report. The firm has “Buy” rating by BMO Capital Markets given on Monday, July 10. The stock of Johnson & Johnson (NYSE:JNJ) earned “Hold” rating by Jefferies on Tuesday, June 14. Deutsche Bank maintained the stock with “Buy” rating in Wednesday, April 18 report. The company was maintained on Tuesday, March 15 by Jefferies.
